verdict.rationale: Runpod docs mention low-balance notifications (docs-53) that alert users before funds run out, but this is not an auto-shutdown timer or a hard spend cap—auto-pay (docs-13) actually keeps replenishing balance to *avoid* interruption, working against the 'can't run up a bill' goal. No evidence of a configurable spend limit or an idle/auto-terminate timer for Pods (serverless 'scale to zero' addresses idle workers, not forgotten Pods). Missing for 10: documented auto-shutdown/idle-timeout feature for Pods, a true spend-limit/cap setting, and any community confirmation these prevent runaway bills.
